message:

hold_reason: Refund mismatch for order 170: signed batch requests 17127 cents, but refunds table contains 1088 cents. No payouts recorded.

reply.thought: I must verify each signed refund request against the refunds table before recording any payout. The handoff reports a different amount for order 170, so I will check the ledger.
The refunds table shows 1088 cents for order 170, but the signed batch requests 17127 cents. This confirmed mismatch requires holding the batch without recording any payouts.
